description.text:
One of the two expansions that opened the Pokémon Card Game XY series on 13 December 2013, released together with Collection Y for the Nintendo 3DS games Pokémon X and Y. Its headline is the legendary Xerneas as a Pokémon-EX, joined by Venusaur-EX and its Mega Evolution M Venusaur-EX, and by Skarmory-EX, which strikes Fairy-type Pokémon for Weakness. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 60, followed by full-art Super Rare Venusaur-EX, Skarmory-EX and Xerneas-EX; these first XY packs have no Ultra Rares. In English most of its cards came out in XY in February 2014.

XY brought the games' two big changes to the cards. Fairy, new in X and Y, became the card game's eleventh type, with its own Fairy Energy, after making its debut a month earlier in the XY Beginning Set, and Fairy Pokémon were the first to resist Darkness. Mega Evolution arrived as M Pokémon-EX, a new kind of card with an M before its name that evolves from a Pokémon-EX, and Mega Evolving ends your turn, so a player chooses between attacking and growing a Mega. Pokémon-EX carried on from BW, now including evolved Pokémon printed as Basic Pokémon that can be played at once.
